summary: Full E2E test of 'Pagar cuenta' feature (public + admin) executed successfully. Backend endpoints /api/public/account/lookup (DNI + lineNumber), /api/public/account/checkout, and /api/admin/payments all work correctly. Public UI: header-paybill-btn navigates to /pagar-cuenta; DNI 12345678A lookup returns Juan, 352.42 €, 12 invoices; NOEXISTE999 returns 404 and toast 'No encontramos ninguna cuenta con esos datos...' is shown while paybill-result card stays hidden; pay button ('Pagar 352.42 €') redirects to checkout.stripe.com. Admin: login admin@goroky.com / Goroky2026! works; sidebar item 'Pagos recibidos' (data-testid=nav-pagos) navigates to /app/payments; page loads without errors, shows 'Aún no hay pagos registrados.' and payments-total 0.00 €.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (>2800 lines). Consider splitting into routers (public, admin, billing, payments, etc.) for maintainability.
PublicCatalog.js is 552 lines and mixes header, hero, plans, coverage and modals - splitting into subcomponents would improve reuse and readability.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seed cliente 12345678A (Juan García) with 12 pending invoices totaling 352.42 €.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature 'Pagar cuenta' is fully working end-to-end. Public flow lookup+checkout confirmed with real Stripe test URL. Admin panel Pagos recibidos loads with empty state (0 payments). To validate a completed payment appearing in the admin list, real Stripe checkout completion (test card 4242...) is required, which was out of scope per the review request.
